parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content in the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese.
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page in paging query. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: ScanRange
parameters.description:
The scan scope. Valid values:

- **image**: Image.
- **container**: Container.
